subject.title: Feature request: per-message token/cost metadata in mobile app and channel surfaces

question: Should Android match the shared Apple default by automatically showing the compact footer on completed assistant replies?
rationale: The implementation path and data contract are clear, but automatic visibility versus a new native preference is a user-facing mobile UX choice.

options.title: Match Apple Default
options.body: Show the footer automatically whenever a completed assistant message has supported usage, keeping native mobile behavior consistent.

options.title: Add Native Preference
options.body: Gate the footer behind a mobile setting, accepting additional settings and persistence complexity.

recommendation.title: Match Apple Default
recommendation.body: Show the footer automatically whenever a completed assistant message has supported usage, keeping native mobile behavior consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across both the Android chat surface and the merged Apple parity implementation.
